subject.title: fix(hooks): bound hook workspace manifest and HOOK.md reads

question: Should hook `package.json` or `HOOK.md` files above 1 MiB be silently omitted from runtime, status, and CLI discovery, or surfaced through an actionable diagnostic?
rationale: The cap fixes a real availability problem but introduces a new supported-size boundary with observable compatibility effects across every hook source.

options.title: Add a diagnostic
options.body: Keep the 1 MiB limit and identify the skipped hook and oversized metadata file through existing hook warning or status output.

options.title: Approve silent omission
options.body: Declare metadata above 1 MiB unsupported and accept omission across runtime, status, and CLI surfaces.

options.title: Unify hook metadata policy
options.body: Pause until this PR and the install-validation PR share one approved size limit and failure contract.

recommendation.title: Add a diagnostic
recommendation.body: Keep the 1 MiB limit and identify the skipped hook and oversized metadata file through existing hook warning or status output.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current-main workspace boundary logic and shared descriptor helper directly implicated by this choice.
